steps.rotations.summary.droughtNote: A drought year means the {rootZone} was among the driest fifth of growing seasons on record at this field, by NASA POWER's {wetness}. Over the whole record that is close to 1 year in 5 by definition, so the count for recent seasons is what tells you whether droughts are getting more common. Both are a {model}, not a measurement on your field.
steps.rotations.rangeNote: Under climate resilience, the range is a {range}: most past years fall inside it. Under soil health, it runs from the low to the high values the sources give, or 15% either side where a source gives a single value.
